instruction: Buy me the cheapest insect repellent on amazon that will reach my home within 5 days. My payment cards do not have any money. So please transfer the minimum required money for the order from venmo to a card first.
notes: Apps modeled as constants (amazon, venmo). The product is a placeholder object whose id is resolved by amazon.search_products (filter product_type == insect repellent, delivery_days <= 5, pick min price). The cart is cleared on add (clear_cart_first=true) so the order has exactly one item of quantity 1. The amount withdrawn from Venmo is the cart total from amazon.show_cart, matching the order's paid_amount. Amazon and Venmo keep separate payment-card records for the same physical card, so two card objects linked by the static (same-card) predicate are used: the venmo card id is funded via withdraw_from_venmo_balance and the matching amazon card id pays the order. The home address id comes from amazon.show_addresses (no address is created/updated). supervisor-complete-task takes only record parameters (no answer) and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions.

plan: (amazon-place-order amazon-card-1 jose-home-address amazon-token cheapest-insect-repellent venmo-card-1 amount-order-total)
